tasks.instruction: Validate latest search_tda_rules payload before storing it in React state: preserve null/undefined as empty results, reject non-array data, null/nonobject rows, non-number/non-safe-positive-integer rule_number and non-string title_ja. Malformed latest payload must show fixed localized recoverable search error without render crash, raw payload echo or scoring/content/DB changes; next query must succeed. Preserve latest-request guards including immediate invalidation/clear/unmount and earlier saved-answer checks. Do not alter original rules corpus, SQL, auth or tests. Only src/TDA.tsx may change. Fixed browser9 baseline has old5PASS/new4FAIL, protected saved-answer14 remain PASS. Dependencies outside preparedworktree, cache in owned temp.
